Workload assumptions (editable)

Fixed conversation sample, not live session usage or a measured task cost. Treat these quantities as one representative request. Billable output must include reasoning output when charged; do not count those tokens twice.

Workload cost = sum of token quantity x bucket rate / 1,000,000. Cache-write tokens use the input rate when there is no separate write price. Long-context prices apply when total prompt tokens exceed the model's threshold.

Value = (score / category best score)^2 / (workload cost / cheapest eligible workload cost). Compare only within this category, effort, and benchmark snapshot. This is a heuristic, not a measured accuracy ratio.

Different models and efforts may consume different token quantities. Benchmark configurations do not guarantee that the same settings or fallback behavior are available in your CLI. Missing or qualified scores never win a recommendation.
